content.rendered:
OHSAS 18001

OHSAS 1800:2007 Occupational Health and Safety Management Certification is an international standard which provides a framework to identify, control and decrease the risks associated with health and safety within the workplace. Implementing the standard will send a clear signal to your stakeholders that we monitor our employee’s health and safety as a priority within our organisation which protects employees against possible occupational risks and reduces the likelihood of accidents in the workplace. By planning ahead our organisation can also identify health and safety risks and conform to health and safety legislation.
